name: Clean inherited Claude/terminal environment at startup
description: If the manager is started from inside a Claude Code session, env vars passed down are removed so new sessions get colors and are not treated as sub-sessions.
behavior_details: At startup removes every env var matching ^(NO_COLOR|CLAUDECODE|CLAUDE_PID|CLAUDE_CODE_.+|GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT)$ from the process env, so all child shells inherit a clean env. CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is NOT removed here (it is used as an extra profile and as default account).
cross_platform_plan: In Rust pty spawn (pty.rs) build CommandBuilder env from std::env::vars() minus the same regex; also apply in any external-terminal launch. On macOS, GUI apps launched from Finder get a minimal env: additionally resolve the user's login-shell PATH (run `$SHELL -ilc 'env'` once at startup, or fix-path-env crate) so `claude` is found.

name: Settings file and schema
description: All preferences persist in a JSON file and survive restarts.
behavior_details: Path %APPDATA%\ClaudeManager\settings.json (dir auto-created). Defaults: pinned=[] (pinned project folders), account=null, openIn='external' ('external'|'embed'), showPicker=true, lastProfile=null (path or 'all'), groups=[] each {name:string, folders:string[] (empties dropped), collapsed:bool}, ungroupedCollapsed=false, showUsage=true, notify=true, bgTerms (array, only copied if present; used by background-terminal feature in another slice). Load: any parse error -> silently use defaults. If account is empty -> $env:CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR else ~/.claude. Saved with ConvertTo-Json depth 6, UTF-8, whole object rewritten on every change (no debounce). Unknown keys are dropped on save.
cross_platform_plan: Add Rust settings module with serde struct (all fields #[serde(default)], tolerant of bad JSON -> defaults) stored in app config dir: keep %APPDATA%\ClaudeManager\settings.json on Windows to read existing users' settings (migration free), ~/Library/Application Support/ClaudeManager/settings.json on macOS. Commands get_settings/set_settings; write atomically (temp file + rename). Preserve unknown keys via #[serde(flatten)] extra map. Normalize paths for comparisons case-insensitively on Windows only.

name: Cached native UI library build
description: MacUI.cs is compiled once into a DLL keyed by SHA1 of its source; old DLLs deleted; build to temp then move so a failed build never leaves a broken cache.
behavior_details: DLL name MacUI-<12 hex>.dll in settings dir.
cross_platform_plan: Drop: Tauri compiles ahead of time. Optionally delete leftover MacUI-*.dll / OpenConsole-*.exe copies from the old app's settings dir on first run.

name: Resolve pwsh and claude executables
description: Finds pwsh and claude on PATH at startup; claude.exe also supplies the window icon and Explorer menu icon.
behavior_details: Get-Command throws (ErrorAction Stop) if pwsh or claude missing -> app fails to start (no friendly message). Default profile dir = ~/.claude.
cross_platform_plan: Rust: use `which` crate to locate `claude` (Windows: claude.exe/claude.cmd; macOS: also check ~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, ~/.claude/local, npm global after login-shell PATH import). Shell: Windows prefer pwsh, fallback powershell.exe; macOS use $SHELL (zsh default). If claude not found, show a friendly in-app banner with install link instead of crashing.

name: OpenConsole host for embedded tabs
description: Embedded tabs use Windows Terminal's OpenConsole (copied next to settings) so emoji and complex scripts (e.g. Sinhala) render; copies conhost font/color registry settings to it; falls back to conhost.exe.
behavior_details: Finds newest Microsoft.WindowsTerminal_*_x64 package by version in HKCU AppModel repository; copies OpenConsole.exe to OpenConsole-<ver>.exe; deletes older copies; copies HKCU\Console\%SystemRoot%_system32_conhost.exe key to HKCU\Console\<path with \ -> _>.
data_sources: Registry HKCU AppModel Packages, HKCU\Console; settings dir
cross_platform_plan: Drop: xterm.js over portable-pty (ConPTY on Windows) renders Unicode itself. Ensure xterm font stack includes emoji and wide-script fallbacks (e.g. 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Nirmala UI' on Windows; 'SF Mono', Menlo, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Sinhala Sangam MN' on macOS) and load @xterm/addon-unicode11 for correct widths.

name: Light/dark theme following OS
description: App uses macOS-style palette, dark or light depending on the Windows app theme at startup; accent is Claude orange.
behavior_details: Reads HKCU ...Themes\Personalize AppsUseLightTheme==0 -> dark; sets dark app mode for native menus/scrollbars. Read only at startup (no live switch). Dark tokens: Bg #1C1C1E, Side #232325, Card #262628, Alt #2A2A2C, Ctrl #3A3A3C, CtrlHover #48484A, Track #323234, SegSel #636366, Text #F2F2F7, Muted #98989F, Border #3A3A3C, Accent #D97757, AccentHover #E58A6B, Danger #FF453A, Menu #2C2C2E. Light: Bg #ECECEE, Side #F4F4F6, Card #FFFFFF, Alt #F7F7F8, Ctrl #FFFFFF, CtrlHover #F0F0F2, Track #E1E1E6, SegSel #FFFFFF, Text #1D1D1F, Muted #86868B, Border #D6D6DA, Accent #D97757, AccentHover #C4643F, Danger #FF3B30, Menu #F8F8F8. Fonts Segoe UI 9.5 body, semibold variants, Hero 22pt, Segoe MDL2 Assets icons. All sizes DPI-scaled.
cross_platform_plan: CSS custom properties on :root with the exact tokens, switched via @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) so it updates live on both OSes; set Tauri window theme to null (follow system). xterm theme also switched on matchMedia change. Fonts: system-ui / -apple-system, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI'; replace MDL2 glyphs with inline SVG icons (Lucide/SF-like) so they work on macOS. DPI handled by webview.

name: Profile discovery (accounts)
description: Lists Claude config directories as profiles.
behavior_details: Profiles = ~/.claude, plus $env:CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR if set, plus every ~/.claude-* directory (including hidden) that contains projects/ or .credentials.json or settings.json. Paths normalized (full path, trailing slash trimmed), sorted, unique.
cross_platform_plan: Implement in sessions.rs list_profiles with same rules (check existing impl matches: env var, hidden dirs, the 3 marker files). On macOS credentials live in Keychain not .credentials.json, so projects/ or settings.json or .claude.json should also count; consider adding .claude.json marker. Dedupe case-insensitively on Windows only.

name: Profile name, initial, color, email
description: Each profile shows a short name, a colored round avatar with its initial, and the signed-in email.
behavior_details: Name: null -> 'All profiles'; leaf '.claude' -> 'default'; else leaf with leading '.claude-' or 'claude-' stripped. Initial: 'All' for all-profiles, else first char uppercased. Color: sum of char codes of name mod 8 into ['#0A84FF','#BF5AF2','#FF375F','#FF9F0A','#30D158','#5E5CE6','#64D2FF','#FF453A']; all-profiles uses Ctrl color with Text ink, others white ink. Email: regex "emailAddress":"..." from ~/.claude.json for default profile, <dir>/.claude.json otherwise; 'Not signed in' if absent; 'Sessions from every profile' for all; cached in memory for app lifetime (not invalidated).
cross_platform_plan: Return name/email from Rust list_profiles (parse JSON properly: oauthAccount.emailAddress, regex fallback). Compute initial/color in TS with the same hash so colors stay identical to the old app. Invalidate email cache on Refresh (F5) and after Add profile.

name: Start profile for new sessions
description: New sessions use the open profile; when viewing All profiles they use the last profile picked (settings.account).
behavior_details: Get-StartAccount = current profile ?? settings.account. Enter-Profile sets settings.account only when a real profile is chosen.
cross_platform_plan: Keep same rule in frontend state; pass profile to pty_spawn.

name: Session file counting and in-memory index
description: All sessions of all profiles are indexed once and patched incrementally from file-watcher changes; switching profiles never re-reads disk.
behavior_details: Files: <profile>/projects/*/*.jsonl (depth 1). Empty sessions skipped. Changed paths matched by ^(.*)\projects\[^\]+\[^\]+\.jsonl$ to derive the profile; removed if deleted. IndexVersion bumps invalidate project-grouping cache keyed on profile|version|pinned. Parsing itself lives in MacUI.cs (Mac.Sessions/Mac.Projects) - other slice.
cross_platform_plan: Rust: keep an index HashMap<path, Session> in managed state, cache by (path, mtime, size); use `notify` crate watcher on each profile's projects dir and emit 'sessions-changed' events with debounced diffs. Use Path components, not backslash regex, for profile derivation.

name: Relative time formatting
description: Last-active times shown as friendly relative text.
behavior_details: MinValue -> 'no sessions'; <1 min 'just now'; <60 min 'Nm ago'; <24h 'Nh ago' (floor); <2 days 'Yesterday'; <7 days 'Nd ago'; same year 'MMM d'; else 'MMM d, yyyy'. Minutes use rounding ([int] cast), hours/days floor.
cross_platform_plan: TS helper with identical thresholds; use Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US',{month:'short',day:'numeric'}) for dates. Refresh labels on a minute timer.

name: Launch terminal (external window or embedded tab)
description: Opens a shell in a folder running a command, either in its own terminal window ('New window') or as a tab inside the app ('Inside app').
behavior_details: If folder missing -> warning dialog 'Folder not found\n<dir>' and abort. pwsh flags -NoExit -NoLogo; command passed Base64 UTF-16 via -EncodedCommand. LateProfile: adds -NoProfile and wraps as try { cmd } finally { dot-source AllUsersAllHosts, AllUsersCurrentHost, CurrentUserAllHosts, CurrentUserCurrentHost profiles } so claude starts ~1s faster and the prompt still loads after Ctrl+C/exit. Embed: start console host hidden, poll every 10ms up to 6000ms for child pwsh and its console window (wait cursor shown), then reparent; on timeout kill it and fall back to external window. Tab title = chat ('PowerShell' default), sub = project (folder leaf).
cross_platform_plan: Embedded: pty_spawn with cwd + shell + args; tab shows immediately (no 6s polling). Validate cwd exists in Rust and return error -> frontend dialog 'Folder not found'. Windows shell: pwsh (fallback powershell) with -NoExit -NoLogo -NoProfile -EncodedCommand and the same try/finally profile loading. macOS: run `$SHELL -l -i -c '<cfg export>; claude <args>; exec $SHELL -l -i'` so the shell stays open after claude exits (equivalent of -NoExit). External window: Windows -> start pwsh (or `wt.exe -d <dir>` if Windows Terminal present) via std::process::Command with CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE; macOS -> AppleScript `tell application "Terminal" to do script "cd <q>; <cmd>"` (or iTerm if installed), via osascript. Quote paths properly per shell.

name: Start Claude with a profile
description: New session / resume launches `claude <args>` with the profile's config dir set.
behavior_details: Default profile (~/.claude): removes CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; other profiles set CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR='<dir>' (single quotes escaped). Tab title default 'New session', sub '<folder leaf>  ·  <profile name>'. Always LateProfile. Callers (new session/resume) are in other slices.
cross_platform_plan: In pty_spawn set/remove CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR on the CommandBuilder directly (no string injection). Compare against default dir after path normalization. Same tab title/sub format.

name: Explorer right-click menu (add/remove)
description: Adds a cascading 'Open Claude Code here' entry to folder and folder-background right-click menus with one 'Profile: <name>' sub-item per profile; can be removed.
behavior_details: Keys HKCU\Software\Classes\Directory\shell\ClaudeCode and ...\Directory\Background\shell\ClaudeCode; MUIVerb, SubCommands='', Icon=claude.exe; sub keys shell\00, 01... with command `"pwsh" -NoExit -NoLogo -WorkingDirectory "%V" -Command "<cfg cmd>; claude"`. Recreated fresh on install (profile list snapshot - not auto-updated when profiles change). Confirmation dialogs: 'Explorer menu added\nRight-click any folder and pick 'Open Claude Code here', with one entry per profile. On Windows 11 it is under 'Show more options'.' and 'Explorer menu removed\n...'. Toggle label in profile popover depends on whether the first key exists.
cross_platform_plan: Windows: implement with winreg crate in Rust (cfg(windows)), same keys so existing installs are detected/removed; consider re-writing entries when profiles change. macOS: replace with a Finder Quick Action/Services entry ('Open Claude Code here') - either ship an Automator .workflow into ~/Library/Services that calls the app via a deep link (claudemanager://open?dir=...&profile=...) using tauri-plugin-deep-link, or hide the menu item on macOS initially. Label: 'Add Finder Quick Action' on macOS.

name: Main window and custom title bar
description: Frameless macOS-style window 'Claude Sessions' with traffic-light buttons, title + subtitle, centered search box, usage ring and profile avatar at right.
behavior_details: Size 1320x820, min 940x560, centered, accepts file drops (handled elsewhere), Claude exe icon. Traffic lights: close, minimize, zoom (toggle maximize); dimmed when window inactive. Title 'Claude Sessions'; subtitle starts 'Loading...' ('Choose a profile' on picker; other text set elsewhere). Drag window by title bar/title/subtitle with single left click; double-click toggles zoom. Layout: avatar 34px at right edge; usage ring 22px 14px left of avatar, vertically centered; search width clamp(200, 380, available), centered but kept >=24px right of subtitle and >=24px left of ring; re-laid out on resize and visibility change. Window padding 14/2/14/14.
cross_platform_plan: Windows: decorations:false + custom HTML title bar with data-tauri-drag-region, own traffic-light (or Windows-style caption) buttons calling window.close/minimize/toggleMaximize; double-click on drag region maximizes natively. macOS: use titleBarStyle 'Overlay' + hiddenTitle so the real native traffic lights are used (no custom ones), reserve ~80px left padding; drag region same. Set minWidth/minHeight 940x560, center, window title. Use window focus/blur events to dim custom lights on Windows. Search/ring/avatar layout via CSS grid (1fr auto 1fr) with clamp widths.

name: Search box
description: Rounded search field in the title bar filtering projects and sessions, with search icon, placeholder and a clear (x) button.
behavior_details: Placeholder 'Search projects and sessions   (Ctrl+F)'. Clear button visible only while text present (visibility toggled elsewhere); hover changes color; click -> Close-Search (other slice) then refocus box. Accent-colored outline while focused. Search cleared when entering a profile. Hidden on the picker screen. Filtering logic and Ctrl+F binding are in later slices.
cross_platform_plan: <input type=search> styled pill with focus ring in --accent; clear button shown via :placeholder-shown CSS. Shortcut Ctrl+F on Windows / Cmd+F on macOS (show correct label in placeholder per platform). Esc clears.

name: Toolbar 'Open in' segmented control and ... menu
description: Segmented control 'New window' | 'Inside app' choosing where sessions open, plus an 'Open in' label and a '...' more button.
behavior_details: Selected index from settings.openIn ('embed' -> 1 else 0); change writes openIn ('external'/'embed') and saves immediately. More button shows moreMenu (contents built elsewhere) 4px below. Comment says the ... menu lives in the title bar (placement done in another slice via Update-Toolbar). Toolbar 46px, left/right flow panels.
cross_platform_plan: Segmented control in HTML; persist via set_settings. Default 'embed' may be better for Tauri but keep 'external' default for parity with existing settings. Ellipsis menu as HTML popover menu (see menus).

name: Body layout: Workspace sidebar card and Sessions card
description: Split view: left rounded card 'Workspace' (project list) and right card 'Sessions' (table) with counts in headers and a details pane at the bottom.
behavior_details: Splitter 10px, left panel fixed on resize, initial width 340px (user-draggable, not persisted). Cards radius 12, header 42px with title (H2) and muted count label. Sidebar rows 32px with section font 7.5 semibold; sessions rows 36px, header 30px, zebra stripes, multi-select (Ctrl/Shift-click). Columns: Session 400 (flexible), Messages 90, Last active 105, Profile 85, Size 75. Details pane 92px at bottom with wrapped text (ellipsis) and a muted meta line, top border line inset 10px. Lists use spring scrolling, overlay scrollbar, animated selection (MacUI). Filling logic in other slices.
cross_platform_plan: CSS grid with draggable splitter (pointer events), min widths; optionally persist sidebar width in settings (new key). Virtualized list for sessions; table header with same columns; selection model with Ctrl/Cmd and Shift click (Cmd on macOS). spring.ts for smooth scroll; overlay scrollbars via CSS (macOS native already overlay).

name: Sidebar '+' add menu
description: A '+' button in the Workspace header opens a menu: 'New project...' and 'Add folder...'.
behavior_details: Menu built lazily on first click; shown right-aligned under the button (offset width-200, +4px). Actions New-ProjectGroup and Do-AddFolder defined in other slices (groups stored in settings.groups).
cross_platform_plan: HTML popover menu anchored to button; 'Add folder...' uses tauri-plugin-dialog open({directory:true}) on both OSes.

name: Usage ring and popover (hover)
description: Small ring in title bar showing share of the busiest recent 5-hour window used by the current one; hovering shows a usage popover; click toggles the usage panel.
behavior_details: Popover uses Mac.UsagePopup; plan numbers cached in %APPDATA%\ClaudeManager\usage-cache.json so popover is never empty. On window activation, if app loaded, picker not visible, and plans missing/errored -> retry Update-Usage (self-heal after sign-in refresh). Usage refreshed on profile enter. Data/compute in MacUI.cs and later slices; settings.showUsage key.
cross_platform_plan: SVG ring component + hover popover; Rust command get_usage with cache file in app data dir; on window focus event retry if last fetch failed. Note macOS OAuth token is in Keychain ('Claude Code-credentials') - read via security-framework crate; Windows from <profile>/.credentials.json.

name: Styled context menus with shortcuts, icons, danger items
description: All menus use a custom macOS-like renderer; items may show a glyph icon, a right-aligned shortcut, red 'danger' styling, separators, and submenu markers.
behavior_details: Item spec @('Text\tShortcut', action, glyph, 'danger'); '-' = separator; empty action = submenu parent. Menu font = body font. Dialog font set for Mac.Dlg.
cross_platform_plan: Build one reusable HTML menu component (keyboard navigable: arrows, Enter, Esc, submenus, closes on blur/scroll) supporting icon, shortcut text, danger, separator, submenu. Shortcut labels rendered per platform (Ctrl vs Cmd glyphs). Alternatively Tauri native Menu.popup for right-click on macOS, but HTML keeps the look consistent; prefer HTML.

name: Custom message dialogs
description: In-app styled dialogs (Mac.Dlg) for warnings, info and Yes/No confirmations.
behavior_details: Used for: folder not found (OK, Warning), Explorer menu added/removed (info), close terminal (YesNo, Question). Text first line acts as title/bold.
cross_platform_plan: HTML modal dialog component (focus trap, Enter = default, Esc = cancel), first line bold. Or tauri-plugin-dialog ask/message for native feel; prefer HTML for consistent theme.

name: Profile picker screen (Chrome style)
description: Full-window 'Who's using Claude Code?' screen with a card per profile, an 'All profiles' card and an 'Add profile' card, plus a toggle 'Show this screen when the app starts'.
behavior_details: Subtitle 'Pick a profile to see its projects and sessions. Switch any time from the picture at the top right.' Cards 176x206, radius 14, 84px avatar, name, email, 'N session(s)' count (from index via Projects.CountFor if loaded, else counting .jsonl files; All = sum over profiles). Add card: '+' avatar, 'Add profile', 'Sign in to another account' -> Do-NewProfile (other slice). Hover: card fill CtrlHover + accent stroke at 70% alpha; hover state kept while cursor inside card children. Click anywhere on card -> Enter-Profile. Cards wrap only when window narrower than needed (max width = window-60, min 420); block vertically centered, 20px above center, min top 20. Cards rebuilt only when profile list changes (key = joined paths) - so counts can be stale. Showing picker hides toolbar, tab bar, body, search, avatar, usage ring; subtitle 'Choose a profile'. Toggle writes settings.showPicker and saves. Startup choice of picker vs lastProfile is in a later slice.
cross_platform_plan: HTML view with flex-wrap centered cards, CSS hover; keyboard: arrow keys/Tab + Enter to pick. Rebuild cards whenever profiles or counts change (cheap in DOM). Toggle bound to showPicker.

name: Screen cross-fade transition
description: Switching between picker and main view uses a spring cross-fade overlay.
behavior_details: Only animates when app loaded, visible and not minimized; else change applied immediately. Snapshot overlay covers client area, changes applied with layout suspended, overlay fades out.
cross_platform_plan: CSS opacity transition (or View Transitions API in WebView2; WKWebView supports it from Safari 18) with spring.ts easing; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

name: Enter profile
description: Selecting a profile (or All profiles) shows its projects and sessions.
behavior_details: Sets current profile; settings.account = acct if not All; settings.lastProfile = acct path or 'all'; saves. Completes background warmup, Update-Live (live-session detection, other slice), Update-Usage if loaded, recomputes projects. Then: avatar updated, tooltip '<name>  -  <email>', picker hidden, toolbar/body/search/avatar/ring shown, tab bar visible if any terminals, search cleared, project and session lists refilled, focus to project list.
cross_platform_plan: Frontend state action enterProfile(id|null) calling set_settings and list_projects(profile) (filter in Rust or TS); show tooltip via title attribute or custom tooltip.

name: Profile popover menu (avatar click)
description: Clicking the avatar opens a Chrome-style popover: current profile header, 'Switch to' list, actions and toggles.
behavior_details: Header: avatar initial/color, name, email of current (or All profiles). 'Switch to' section (only if any): all other profiles, plus 'All profiles' when a specific profile is open. Actions: 'Add profile' (Do-NewProfile), 'Manage profiles' (Show-Picker), 'Open profile folder' (only when a specific profile open; opens Explorer), toggle 'Finish notifications' (settings.notify, saved), 'Add/Remove Explorer right-click menu' (label by registry state), 'Refresh everything   (F5)' (Refresh-All -Full), 'Close background sessions' (Close-OrphanSessions, other slice). Separators between groups. Shown below the avatar.
cross_platform_plan: HTML popover anchored to avatar, closes on outside click/Esc/window blur. 'Open profile folder' via tauri-plugin-opener revealItemInDir / open path (Explorer on Windows, Finder on macOS - label 'Show in Finder' on macOS). Explorer menu item: Windows only (or Finder Quick Action on macOS). F5 label: Windows 'F5', macOS 'Cmd+R'. Notifications toggle uses tauri-plugin-notification (request permission on macOS when enabled).

name: Terminal tab bar
description: A tab strip appears above the body when terminals are open inside the app; each tab shows chat title and project subtitle with close and pop-out buttons; selecting a tab shows that terminal, deselecting shows the sessions view.
behavior_details: Bar 42px, hidden when no terminals or when picker visible. Events: TabSelected -> Select-Term, TabClosed -> Close-Term, TabPopOut -> PopOut-Term (pop-out impl in next slice). Tools docked right of the strip added later. Select-Term(null) shows the split (sessions) view and focuses project list; selecting a terminal hides the split, shows only that host, resizes it to fill and focuses it. Window activation refocuses the active terminal. Toolbar updated on switch.
cross_platform_plan: HTML tab strip; one xterm.js instance per tab kept alive (display:none for hidden, call fit addon on show and on ResizeObserver -> pty_resize). Focus term.focus() on window focus event. Home/sessions view acts as the 'no tab selected' state (consider a fixed Home tab). Keyboard shortcuts for tab switching defined elsewhere.

name: Embed console window into tab
description: Creates a tab hosting the reparented console window.
behavior_details: Host panel black background; stores hwnd, conhost pid, shell pid, dir, chat, project, original window style; finds window thread for input focus; resizes child window on host resize (MoveWindow). New tab is selected immediately.
cross_platform_plan: Replace with xterm.js + portable-pty (already in pty.rs). Tab record: {ptyId, chat, project, dir, profile, shellPid}. Keep shell pid from pty child for live-session detection and cleanup.

name: Tab title from terminal title
description: Tab title updates to the chat name that Claude sets as the terminal title.
behavior_details: Strip leading non-letter/digit chars (Claude spinner symbols) and trim; ignore empty or generic titles matching ^(claude( code)?|pwsh|powershell|windows powershell|administrator\b.*|.*\\[^\\]+\.exe)$ (case-insensitive); rename only if changed. Polling of console titles is in another slice.
cross_platform_plan: Use xterm.js onTitleChange event (OSC sequences pass through ConPTY and macOS pty) and apply the same cleanup regex; extend generic list with zsh/bash/-zsh/login and paths ending in shell names for macOS.

name: Close terminal tab with confirmation
description: Closing a tab asks for confirmation, then ends the terminal.
behavior_details:
Dialog title 'Close terminal', YesNo: 'Close this terminal?

<chat>
<project>

The Claude session is saved and can be resumed later.' On Yes: sends WM_CLOSE to console, removes tab, disposes host; if it was active, returns to sessions view, else just restyles. Remove-Term also used when a process exits on its own (other slice).
cross_platform_plan: HTML confirm dialog; on Yes call pty_kill(id) which must kill the whole process tree (Windows: job object or taskkill /T; macOS: kill process group with SIGHUP then SIGKILL) so claude does not linger. On pty exit event, remove tab automatically. Middle-click on tab = close (nice).

name: Window activation behaviors
description: On focus: traffic lights active, active terminal focused, usage self-heal; on blur: lights dim; resize repaints.
behavior_details: See title bar and usage features.
cross_platform_plan: Listen to getCurrentWindow().onFocusChanged in TS.

name: Small UI helpers (truncate with ellipsis, buttons, labels)
description: Text truncated with '…' at a max length; buttons Mac-style (primary/secondary/plain) 30px high with optional glyph; labels never treat '&' as mnemonic.
behavior_details: Get-Short(text,max): if longer, take max-1 chars, trim end, append U+2026.
cross_platform_plan: CSS text-overflow: ellipsis plus TS truncate helper where fixed length needed; button classes .btn-primary/.btn-secondary/.btn-plain.

name: Close terminal tab with confirmation
description: Closing an in-app terminal tab asks 'Close this terminal?' showing the tab's chat name and project, noting the Claude session is saved and can be resumed. On Yes the terminal is closed and its tab removed.
behavior_details:
Close-Term: YesNo Question dialog, title 'Close terminal', body "Close this terminal?

<Chat>
<Project>

The Claude session is saved and can be resumed later.". On Yes posts WM_CLOSE to the console window, then Remove-Term. Remove-Term: removes from Terms list and tab strip, disposes host; if it was the active tab, selects null (falls back to Sessions view), else restyles tabs. Reached from tab right-click 'Close terminal' (danger style) and tab close button (other slice).
cross_platform_plan: Tauri: frontend shows custom modal (same text), then invoke pty_kill(id) (kill child process tree: on Windows kill ConPTY child + descendants; on macOS send SIGHUP to process group then SIGKILL after timeout). Dispose xterm instance, remove tab, activate Sessions view if it was active.

name: Pop out terminal to its own window
description: Tab right-click 'Pop out to its own window' detaches the embedded console and makes it a normal top-level window offset 60px from the app, 1100x680.
behavior_details: PopOut-Term: Host.Detach, Win.Native.Unembed(hwnd, originalStyle, form.Left+60, form.Top+60, 1100, 680) (DPI-scaled Px), then Remove-Term. The process keeps running.
cross_platform_plan: With xterm.js+portable-pty there is no native window to unembed. Implement as a new Tauri WebviewWindow (label term-<id>) hosting the same xterm bound to the same PTY id (PTY lives in Rust state, so re-attach the Channel to the new window; buffer recent output in Rust ring buffer for replay). Size 1100x680, positioned main.x+60,y+60. Works identically on Windows/macOS. Optionally allow 'dock back' into tabs.

name: Terminal liveness and title polling (1 s)
description: Tabs disappear automatically when their terminal process ends (e.g. user types exit), and the tab label picks up the chat name Claude Code puts in the terminal title.
behavior_details: termTimer interval 1000 ms: for each term, if HWND no longer a window -> Remove-Term; else Set-TermChat(t, Get-ChatName(window title)). Get-ChatName/Set-TermChat defined elsewhere (dependency on slice <700: parses title, strips spinner glyphs/'Claude Code' prefix).
cross_platform_plan: Event-driven instead of polling: pty.rs reader thread emits Exit event on EOF/child wait -> frontend removes tab (or shows 'process exited' and closes). Title: xterm.js onTitleChange (OSC 0/2 sequences emitted by Claude Code) -> apply same Get-ChatName cleanup in TS -> rename tab. Same on both OSes.

name: Quit with open terminals: keep running in background / close / cancel
description: When closing the app with in-app terminals open, a 3-button dialog: '<n> terminal(s) is/are still open inside the app' — 'Keep running in the background? Claude can keep working, and they come back as tabs the next time you open the app. Closing them ends them; the sessions stay saved and can be resumed.' Buttons: Cancel (secondary), Close terminals (danger), Keep running (primary, default). Escape = Cancel.
behavior_details: FormClosing: hides+disposes tray icon first; if Terms.Count>0 shows Mac.Ask with default index 2, cancel index 0. Choice 0 -> cancel close. 2 -> Send-TermsToBackground. 1 -> Close-AllTerms. Then stops termTimer. Plural 'terminal is'/'terminals are'.
cross_platform_plan: Tauri: intercept WindowEvent::CloseRequested (prevent_close) and on macOS also app Cmd+Q via RunEvent::ExitRequested; frontend shows modal. 'Keep running' requires PTYs to outlive the UI: run a small background PTY host (sidecar daemon, or keep the Tauri process alive with window hidden + tray/menu-bar icon). Recommended: keep the process alive hidden (tray on Windows, menu-bar/Dock on macOS) — simplest and cross-platform; on relaunch (single-instance plugin) re-show window with tabs intact. A true detach-and-reattach across app restarts would need a sidecar PTY server (or tmux on macOS) — note as later option. 'Close terminals' -> pty_kill_all then exit.

name: Send terminals to background (persist)
description: Hides each embedded console window and records it so the next app launch can re-embed it.
behavior_details: Send-TermsToBackground: Settings.bgTerms = array of {shellPid, conhostPid, chat, project, dir}; each host Detach + UnembedHidden(hwnd, style); Save-Settings. Close-AllTerms: bgTerms=@(), WM_CLOSE to every terminal, Save-Settings.
cross_platform_plan: Hidden-HWND trick is Windows-only. In Tauri keep PTYs in the Rust process; 'background' = hide window, keep process alive. If cross-restart persistence is wanted, a sidecar PTY daemon keyed by id with saved metadata {id, chat, project, dir, profile, sessionId} in settings.json bgTerms; otherwise drop bgTerms and instead record sessions to offer 'Resume' on next start.

name: Restore background terminals on start
description: Terminals left running in the background last time come back as tabs; the app still lands on the Sessions view.
behavior_details: Restore-BackgroundTerms: for each bgTerms entry, skip if shellPid missing or process gone; find console window for shell pid; Add-TerminalTab(hwnd, chat, project, conhostPid, shellPid, dir). Then clears bgTerms and saves. If any restored, Select-Term $null (Sessions view focused, tabs waiting).
cross_platform_plan: If keep-alive-in-process approach: unnecessary (window just re-shows). With sidecar daemon: on start list daemon sessions, re-create xterm tabs, replay scrollback buffer, keep Sessions view active.

name: Sidebar tree: projects (groups) and folders
description: Left sidebar lists user-defined projects (groups of folder references) with chevrons and group icon, then an Ungrouped section with folders (folder/star-pinned/missing icons). Groups can be collapsed; long groups show 'Show N more' row. Live indicators on rows.
behavior_details: Fill-Projects builds rows via Mac.Tree.Build(AllProjects, group names, group folders, collapsed flags, ShowAllFolders per group, Settings.ungroupedCollapsed, query '', icons for Folder/Star(pinned)/Missing/Group/ChevRight/ChevDown, accent, muted). Row kinds: section, group, folder, more. Set-RowLive applied. Keeps selection; if none selects first row (without firing). Search is NOT applied to the lists (q=''; search uses its own dropdown).
data_sources: settings.json groups [{name, folders[], collapsed}], ungroupedCollapsed, pinned; project list from session index.
cross_platform_plan: TS tree renderer in main.ts from list_projects + settings (new get_settings/save_settings commands in Rust storing settings.json in app config dir or existing path). Path comparisons: case-insensitive + trim trailing separator on Windows; case-sensitive on macOS (APFS usually insensitive, but compare normalized). Missing-folder icon when path doesn't exist (Rust checks).

name: Header subtitle counts
description: Title subtitle reads '<Profile name> · N session(s) · N folder(s) · N project(s)' (projects part only if any groups).
behavior_details: Total = sum of Sessions.Count across AllProjects; folders = AllProjects count; projects = groups count; singular/plural handled. projCount label cleared.
cross_platform_plan: Compute in TS after loading projects; same string.

name: Session list columns (folder vs project view)
description: Selecting a folder shows columns Session(400, flexible), Messages(90), Last active(105), Profile(85), Size(75). Selecting a project (group) shows Session(400), Folder(150), Messages, Last active, Profile (no Size).
behavior_details: Set-SessionColumns only rebuilds when mode changes. Size formatted '{N:N1} MB' if >=1024 KB else 'N KB'. Folder column = leaf name of session cwd. Last active = relative 'ago' text (Mac.Projects.Ago), or 'Working...' if live level 2, or 'Open now' if live level 1. Row has chat icon, Key=session id, Live level drives indicator. Count label: 'N   in   <folder leaf>' or 'N   in   <group name>'. Global search mode exists in code but disabled (q='').
data_sources: Session index (jsonl parsed: Label, Full, Count, Time, Account, SizeKB, Cwd, Id, File), Live map.
cross_platform_plan: Render table in TS; sessions.rs must expose all fields (label, full text, msg count, mtime, profile, size, cwd, id, file). Ago formatting in TS. Multi-select (Ctrl/Shift; Cmd/Shift on macOS).

name: Details pane
description: Below the list: full first prompt text and meta for the selected session; contextual hints otherwise; Resume/Switch to, Fork, Delete buttons.
behavior_details: Session selected: text = Full prompt; if live prefix 'Claude is working in this session.' (level 2) or 'This session is open.' + ' Double-click to switch to it.' Meta: 'ddd, MMM d yyyy  HH:mm     N messages     profile: X     <id>'. Folder with 0 sessions: 'No sessions yet. Double-click the folder (or press New Session) to start one.' + path. Group: "Project '<name>': N folder(s). Drag folders onto it in the sidebar, or right-click a folder and pick Move to project. Folders on disk are never moved." + folder paths joined by 5 spaces. Else: 'Double-click a project to start a session, or a session to resume it. Drop a folder on the window to start there. Right-click for more.' Actions: visible only with a selection; Resume/Fork only when exactly 1 selected; Resume text becomes 'Switch to' when live; Delete shows icon only for 1, 'Delete N' for multiple. Tooltips: 'Resume this session  (Enter)', 'Continue in a new copy of this session', 'Delete this session  (Del)'.
cross_platform_plan: TS panel; keyboard Enter = resume, Delete (and Backspace/Cmd+Backspace on macOS) = delete. Date format via Intl.

name: Background warm-up of session files + picker priming
description: At start all session files are parsed on background threads so opening a profile is instant; while the profile picker is visible, main-view code is pre-run in small steps; picker card session counts update in place.
behavior_details: Start-Warmup: Get-SessionFiles -> Mac.Sessions.WarmAsync(paths, accounts); 50 ms timer polls WarmDone -> Complete-Warmup (once): WaitWarm, Build-Index if none; if picker visible run PrimeSteps on 40 ms timer (one step per tick, Profile restored after each) else Update-CardCounts. Update-CardCounts: for each non-'Add' card, label 'count' = 'N session(s)' via CountFor(index, acct).
cross_platform_plan: Drop JIT priming (PowerShell-specific). Keep: Rust parses index on a background thread at startup (rayon), caches; emits 'index-ready' event; picker cards update counts. Optionally persist an index cache keyed by mtime/size.

name: File watchers for incremental refresh
description: Session changes on disk appear automatically; only changed files are re-read.
behavior_details: FileSystemWatcher per profile on <acct>/projects, filter *.jsonl, recursive, NotifyFilter FileName|LastWrite|Size; Changed/Created/Deleted/Renamed add FullPath (and OldFullPath) to case-insensitive Changed set. Consumed by liveTimer -> Refresh-All. Watchers enabled after window exists.
cross_platform_plan: Rust notify crate (ReadDirectoryChangesW on Windows, FSEvents on macOS) with debouncer (~300-500 ms); keep a dirty set; re-parse only those files and emit 'sessions-changed' to frontend. Case-insensitive set on Windows only.

name: Refresh (F5 full rescan)
description: Refresh re-reads projects; F5 / 'Refresh' menu item does a full rescan dropping the index.
behavior_details: Refresh-All: no-op while picker visible; -Full sets Index=null; then Get-Projects, Fill-Projects, Fill-Sessions. Menu item text 'Refresh\tF5'.
cross_platform_plan: F5 on Windows, Cmd+R on macOS (also F5); invoke rescan command that clears cache.

name: Live session detection
description: Sessions currently running are marked 'Open now' (level 1) or 'Working...' (level 2); folders/projects in sidebar show the highest live level among their folders.
behavior_details: Update-Live: Mac.LiveScan.Scan(accounts) reads <profile>/sessions/<pid>.json (older) or <pid>.<hash>.key (newer) (scanner in MacUI.cs). Duplicate session ids from several processes: prefer reachable one (has window via Test-SessionReachable walking up to 6 parents for MainWindowHandle/console window), else higher Level. LiveCwd[lower(cwd trimmed '\')] = max level. Returns whether signature 'id=level;...' changed. Set-RowLive: folder Live = LiveCwd[path.lower]; group Live = max over folders.
cross_platform_plan: Port LiveScan to Rust (read same files, check pid alive via sysinfo crate on both OSes). Reachability: a session whose pid is a descendant of one of our PTY children is reachable; on Windows also check console/top-level window; on macOS reachable if ancestor is Terminal/iTerm/etc. (sysinfo parent chain). Path key: lowercase only on Windows.

name: Finish / ended notifications (tray toast)
description: A tray icon ('Claude Sessions', Claude exe icon) shows a toast 'Claude finished' when a session goes from working to idle, or 'Claude session ended' if it disappears while working. Clicking the toast restores the app and focuses that session; double-clicking the tray icon restores the window.
behavior_details: Check-Notify every live tick (even on picker). Disabled when Settings.notify false (resets PrevLive). Transition prev level 2 -> now !=2 fires. Suppressed if window focused and active tab's ShellPid equals the session pid or its parent. Body: session label (from index by id, else cwd leaf, else 'Claude session') + newline + cwd leaf. Balloon 5000 ms, Info icon. NotifyTarget = live info for click. Tray icon disposed on close.
cross_platform_plan: tauri-plugin-notification (Windows toast / macOS UNUserNotification; request permission on macOS). Click action: Windows toast activation and macOS notification click -> event to focus window + Focus-Live (plugin click support is limited; may need on_action / custom). Tray via Tauri TrayIconBuilder (Windows tray; macOS menu bar) with click -> show window. Suppression check uses PTY pid ancestry + window focused.

name: Switch to running session (Focus-Live)
description: Resuming a session that is already running switches to it instead of starting a copy: its in-app tab, otherwise its external console/window, otherwise any Windows Terminal window.
behavior_details: 1) In-app tab whose ShellPid == session pid or its parent -> select tab, restore & bring app forward. 2) Walk up to 7 ancestors: console window or MainWindowHandle -> BringToFront (restores if minimized/hidden). 3) Any WindowsTerminal process with window. Returns false if nothing found.
cross_platform_plan: Step 1 portable: map PTY child pids (and descendants via sysinfo) to tabs. Step 2 Windows: Rust windows crate EnumWindows/AttachConsole+GetConsoleWindow, SetForegroundWindow/ShowWindow(SW_RESTORE). macOS: find ancestor app (Terminal, iTerm2, etc.) by pid and activate via NSRunningApplication(processIdentifier).activate; can't pick a specific tab without AppleScript (optional: AppleScript for Terminal/iTerm tty matching). Fallback Windows Terminal / Terminal.app activate.

name: Close orphaned background sessions
description: Finds running claude processes with no reachable window (left by killed terminals) and offers to end them.
behavior_details: Scans <profile>/sessions/*.json (current profile, or all when viewing all) for pid; skip dead pids and ones open as in-app tabs; orphan if not reachable. None -> dialog 'No background sessions to close\nEvery running session can be reached from a window.' Else Warning YesNo 'Close N background session(s)?' listing up to 6 '  - <cwd leaf>  (pid N)'. On Yes: kill pid, kill parent if pwsh/powershell/node, delete the json. Then Update-Live, refill lists. (Menu entry for it is outside this slice — dependency.)
cross_platform_plan: Rust: same scan; reachability as above; kill via sysinfo (TerminateProcess / SIGTERM then SIGKILL). Parent shell names: pwsh/powershell/node on Windows; zsh/bash/sh/node/login on macOS.

name: Usage panel refresh
description: Usage popover shows local token usage for the open profile (all profiles when viewing all) and real plan limits (as in /usage) for signed-in profiles.
behavior_details: Update-Usage: usagePanel.Reload(<acct>/projects dirs, profile name); unless -LocalOnly also ReloadPlans(<acct>/.credentials.json for accounts that have it, names). Timing: local every 30 live ticks (60 s), plan limits every 300 ticks (10 min), and on popover open if older than 5 min (popover in other slice). LastPlanRefresh tracked.
data_sources: <profile>/projects/**/*.jsonl token fields; <profile>/.credentials.json (OAuth token) -> Anthropic usage endpoint (in MacUI.cs).
cross_platform_plan: Rust command usage_local(profiles) and usage_plans(profiles) (reqwest). macOS: Claude Code stores credentials in Keychain ('Claude Code-credentials') not .credentials.json — read via security-framework crate, fall back to file. Timers in TS setInterval 60 s / 10 min.

name: 2-second live/refresh loop
description: Every 2 s: update live status, fire notifications, and refresh lists only if files or live state changed.
behavior_details: Skips until Loaded. Update-Live + Check-Notify always (even on picker); returns early if picker visible. Increments LiveTicks for usage cadence. If Changed set non-empty -> Refresh-All; elif live changed -> Fill-Projects/Fill-Sessions. All wrapped in try/catch so a background refresh never crashes the app.
cross_platform_plan: Rust background thread every 2 s computing live map, emitting 'live-changed' only on signature change; file watcher emits changes. Frontend re-renders preserving selection/scroll. Errors logged, never panic.

name: New Session (split button + menu)
description: 'New Session' split button in the Sessions panel header. Main click starts Claude in the selected folder using the default open mode. Arrow menu: New session in new window; New session inside app; New session with profile > (each profile with avatar); separator; radio-checked 'New Session opens in a new window' / 'New Session opens inside the app' to set the default.
behavior_details: Do-New(mode=Settings.openIn): folder -> Start-Claude(path,'',Get-StartAccount,mode). Group -> selected session's cwd if any; else folder-picker menu at cursor ('Start in which folder of <name>?', each folder leaf with path tooltip, or disabled '(no folders yet - drag some in)'). 'with profile' items only act on a selected folder (not group). Tooltip 'Start a Claude session in the selected folder'. Hidden while Source Control view is shown. Start-Claude/Get-StartAccount in other slice.
cross_platform_plan: TS split button + custom dropdown menu. 'embed' = xterm tab via pty_spawn. 'external' = Windows: launch wt.exe/pwsh with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR env; macOS: open Terminal.app (or iTerm) via osascript 'do script "cd <dir> && CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=... claude ..."'. Avatars rendered in HTML.

name: Continue last session
description: Resume the most recent session of the selected folder/project; switches to it if already running.
behavior_details: Do-Continue: s = first (newest) session. If live: Focus-Live; if not found -> Question YesNo 'This session is running elsewhere\nIt's active but its window couldn't be found. Resume anyway? This starts a second copy of the session.' Start-Claude(cwd or folder path, '--resume <id>', s.Account, mode, label). No sessions -> Do-New.
cross_platform_plan: Same logic in TS; pty_spawn args ['--resume', id] with the session's profile config dir.

name: Resume / Switch to / Fork session
description: Resume (Enter / double-click / button) resumes the selected session in its own profile; if running, switches to it. Fork starts '--resume <id> --fork-session' in a new copy titled 'Fork of <label>'.
behavior_details: Do-Resume: needs a selected session; non-fork and live and Focus-Live succeeds -> return (else falls through and resumes, no prompt here). dir = s.Cwd else selected folder path else abort. Chat label passed for the tab title.
cross_platform_plan: TS + pty_spawn; external mode per OS as above.

name: Open in VS Code
description: Open a folder in VS Code, or all folders of a project in one multi-root window.
behavior_details: CodeExe search: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Microsoft VS Code\Code.exe, %ProgramFiles%\..., else 'code' on PATH. Only existing directories passed, quoted. Missing -> dialog 'VS Code was not found on this PC.' Launched hidden window style.
cross_platform_plan: Rust command open_in_code(paths): Windows same lookup (spawn with CREATE_NO_WINDOW); macOS 'open -a "Visual Studio Code" --args <paths>' or /Applications/Visual Studio Code.app/Contents/Resources/app/bin/code, or 'code' on PATH (note GUI apps on macOS lack shell PATH; resolve via login shell). Message 'VS Code was not found.'

name: Open menu (header)
description: 'Open ▾' button: VS Code; Explorer; PowerShell here; separator; Copy path.
behavior_details: Explorer opens selected folder or a group's first folder if it exists. PowerShell here: Start-Terminal(path,'') for folders only. Copy path: folder path to clipboard. Hidden in Source Control view.
cross_platform_plan: Labels per OS: 'Explorer' -> 'Finder' on macOS (tauri-plugin-opener reveal/open path); 'PowerShell here' -> 'Terminal here' (macOS: open -a Terminal <dir>; Windows: wt.exe -d or pwsh). Clipboard via tauri-plugin-clipboard-manager or navigator.clipboard.

name: Terminal tab context menu
description: Right-click a terminal tab: Open folder in VS Code; Open folder in Explorer; Copy folder path; separator; Pop out to its own window; Close terminal (danger).
behavior_details: MenuTerm set from tab tag; actions use term.Dir; Explorer only if dir exists. Shown at cursor.
cross_platform_plan: Custom HTML context menu on tab contextmenu event; Finder label on macOS.

name: Add folder / pin / unpin
description: Add a folder via folder browser ('Pick a project folder') which pins it to the sidebar; Pin / unpin toggles a folder's pinned state (star icon).
behavior_details: Add-Pin: add path to Settings.pinned if absent, save, Refresh-All. Do-TogglePin: if pinned remove entries matching path (TrimEnd '\'), save, refresh; else Add-Pin. Pinned folders show even with no sessions.
cross_platform_plan: tauri-plugin-dialog open({directory:true, title:'Pick a project folder'}); normalize trailing separators per OS.

name: Projects (groups): create, rename, delete, move folders, collapse, show more
description: User projects group folder references (folders on disk never moved). Create via 'New project...', rename, delete (folders return to Ungrouped), Move to project / Remove from project; collapse groups and the Ungrouped section; 'Show N more' expands long groups.
behavior_details: Ask-Name uses Mac.Dlg.Input, trimmed. New: prompt 'Name for the new project. Folders are only referenced here, never moved.'; duplicate name -> "A project named '<name>' already exists."; adds {name, folders:[], collapsed:false}; optional withPath moves folder in. Rename: 'New name:' prefilled; no-op if empty/unchanged; duplicate check. Delete: Warning YesNo "Delete the project '<name>'?\n\nIts N folder(s) go back to Ungrouped. No folders or sessions are deleted." Move-ToGroup: path TrimEnd '\', removed from all groups (one project per folder), appended to target; null = remove. Toggle-Row: 'more' toggles ShowAllFolders[group] (session-only, not saved); group toggles collapsed (saved); section 's:folders' toggles ungroupedCollapsed (saved). Update-Groups = save + refill. Drag-to-group is elsewhere (dependency).
cross_platform_plan: Pure TS state + save_settings command; HTML modal input dialog; same messages.

name: Delete sessions (Recycle Bin)
description: Delete selected session(s) (button or Del) moves transcript and side data to the Recycle Bin after confirmation.
behavior_details: Confirm-Delete: Warning YesNo title 'Delete': 'Move <this session|these N sessions> to the Recycle Bin?' + up to 5 '  - <label>' + '  ... and N more' + 'If one is open in a terminal, close it first.' Remove-SessionFiles: recycle <id>.jsonl, then dirs <jsonl dir>/<id>, <acct>/file-history/<id>, <acct>/session-env/<id> if exist; adds file to Changed for instant list removal. Errors per session swallowed; Refresh-All after.
cross_platform_plan: Rust 'trash' crate (Recycle Bin on Windows, Trash on macOS); wording 'Trash' on macOS. Delete key / Cmd+Backspace on macOS.

name: Delete all sessions of a folder
description: Folder right-click 'Delete all sessions...' recycles every session of that folder and unpins it so it leaves the list (folder itself untouched).
behavior_details: Confirm text: "Move all N sessions of '<leaf>' to the Recycle Bin?" + names. If no sessions, skips confirm and just unpins. Removes from pinned, save, Refresh-All.
cross_platform_plan: Same via trash crate.

name: New profile
description: Create a new Claude profile directory ~/.claude-<name>, launch Claude there to log in, and enter that profile.
behavior_details: Input 'Name for the new profile (letters, numbers, - or _).\nIt will be stored in <HOME>\.claude-<name>', title 'New Claude profile'. Validate ^[\w-]+$ else "That name can't be used\nUse letters, numbers, - or _ only." Create dir, clear email cache, Start-Claude(HOME,'',dir,'external') (first run asks to log in), Enter-Profile(dir).
cross_platform_plan: Rust create_profile; launch in-app PTY (better than external) with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. macOS: note default profile credentials are in Keychain; Claude Code uses per-config-dir keychain entries.

name: More menu (title bar)
description: 'More' menu: New profile...; Manage profiles... (shows picker); separator; Add folder right-click menu in Explorer; Remove folder right-click menu; separator; Refresh (F5).
behavior_details: Install/Remove-ExplorerMenu defined elsewhere (registry shell verbs). Refresh = Refresh-All -Full. Comment notes some actions moved to profile popover.
cross_platform_plan: Explorer context menu: Windows registry HKCU\Software\Classes\Directory\shell + Directory\Background\shell pointing to app exe with --dir arg (deep link / CLI arg via single-instance plugin). macOS equivalent: Finder Quick Action/Service (Automator workflow in ~/Library/Services) or skip; hide item on macOS if not implemented.

name: Folder right-click menu
description: New session; New session in new window; New session inside app; New session with profile >; — Continue last session; — Open PowerShell here; Open in Explorer; Open in VS Code; Copy path; — Move to project > (all projects, current one checked, separator, New project...); Remove from project (only if in a project); — Pin / unpin; Delete all sessions... (danger).
behavior_details: Submenus rebuilt on opening. Shown on mouse-up right-click by row kind.
cross_platform_plan: HTML context menu (or Tauri native Menu popup for native feel on macOS). OS-specific labels (Finder/Terminal).

name: Project (group) and empty-area right-click menus
description: Group menu: New session in... (folder picker); Continue last session; — Open in VS Code (multi-root); — Rename project...; Delete project (danger); — New project.... Right-click on section/empty area: New project....
behavior_details: Menu chosen by projList.RowAt; group -> groupMenu; folder -> folderMenu; else ungroupedMenu.
cross_platform_plan: HTML context menus as above.

name: Sessions header layout / toolbar visibility
description: New Session and Open sit at the right of the Sessions panel header left of the Sessions | Source Control switch; in Source Control view they're replaced by refresh/push/pull/fetch icons and repo/branch/sync label. Search box hidden while a terminal tab is in front.
behavior_details: Layout-SessHead on resize; Update-Toolbar: New/Open visible only when git view hidden; searchWrap visible only when no active terminal and picker not visible. Git view in other slice.
cross_platform_plan: CSS flex layout; toggle classes by view state.

name: Project group context menu (tail) and ungrouped menu
description: Right-click on a project group row shows: ... | Open in VS Code | Rename project... | Delete project (danger, red) | New project.... Right-click on blank space/Ungrouped shows only 'New project...'. Each item has a Segoe MDL2 glyph icon.
behavior_details: Menu chosen on MouseUp with Right button via projList.RowAt(location): Kind 'group' -> groupMenu, 'folder' -> folderMenu, else ungroupedMenu. Menu is shown at the cursor. Rename -> Rename-ProjectGroup, Delete -> Remove-ProjectGroup (confirmation lives in another slice). New project -> New-ProjectGroup. Glyphs: VS Code E943, rename E70F, delete E74D, new E7B8. Separators between blocks.
cross_platform_plan: Build an HTML context menu component (or Tauri 2 native Menu via @tauri-apps/api/menu Menu.popup()). Native menus look right on macOS; a custom HTML menu gives the danger-red item and icons on both. Hit-test row kind from the clicked DOM row's data-kind. On macOS also trigger on ctrl+click (contextmenu event covers this).

name: Session list context menu
description: Right-click a session: Resume (Enter) | Resume in new window | Resume inside app | Fork as a new session | Copy session ID | Open folder in VS Code | Show file in Explorer | Delete (Del, danger).
behavior_details: Resume -> Do-Resume (default mode from settings.openIn). 'new window' -> Mode external; 'inside app' -> Mode embed (embedded terminal); Fork -> Do-Resume -Fork (claude --resume <id> --fork-session, defined in other slice). Copy session ID -> clipboard SetText(session.Id). Open folder in VS Code -> Open-InCode(session.Cwd). Show file in Explorer -> explorer.exe /select,"<jsonl file>". Delete -> Do-DeleteSession. Shortcut hints shown right-aligned via tab char ('Resume\tEnter', 'Delete\tDel').
data_sources: Session objects (Id, Cwd, File = ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<id>.jsonl); clipboard; VS Code exe
cross_platform_plan: Same menu in Tauri. Copy ID via navigator.clipboard or tauri-plugin-clipboard-manager. 'Show file in Explorer' -> label 'Reveal in Finder' on macOS / 'Show in Explorer' on Windows; implement with tauri-plugin-opener revealItemInDir (opener already in Cargo.toml). 'Resume in new window' must open Terminal.app/iTerm via osascript on macOS and wt.exe/pwsh on Windows (dependency: launching slice). Show shortcut hints as Enter / Del (Windows) and Return / Cmd+Backspace (macOS).

name: Sessions | Source Control view switch
description: Segmented control in the right card header toggles the right panel between the Sessions list+details and a VS Code style Source Control view for the folder/project selected in the sidebar.
behavior_details: Segmented items 'Sessions','Source Control', 230x28, anchored top-right. Show-GitView(on): hides sessList and details, shows gitView; header title text becomes 'Source Control' / 'Sessions'; hides New/Open buttons in git mode; shows fetch/pull/push/refresh icon buttons; branch pill, repo picker and sync label hidden when leaving. Session count label repositioned after title. Entering: PerformLayout, Fit-GitSplit, Refresh-Git. Leaving: Fill-Sessions. Layout-SessHead re-run whenever any header control changes size/visibility or sessCount text changes. The view choice is NOT persisted (always starts on Sessions).
cross_platform_plan: Segmented control in the header (HTML). Keep header layout in CSS flex so the git controls auto-arrange (no manual Layout-SessHead). Optionally persist last view in localStorage/settings (improvement, not parity).

name: Source control header toolbar (repo picker, branch pill, sync state, fetch/pull/push/refresh)
description: In git mode the header shows: repo picker button (only when several repos), branch pill button with branch glyph, sync label ('not published' / '↑N ↓M' / 'up to date'), and icon buttons Fetch, Pull, Push, Refresh with tooltips. Pull/Push buttons show the behind/ahead count as text.
behavior_details: Fetch -> git fetch --prune ('Fetching...'). Pull -> git pull ('Pulling...'). Push -> Invoke-GitPush: if upstream exists 'git push' ('Pushing...') else 'git push -u origin HEAD' ('Publishing branch...'). Refresh -> Refresh-Git. Tooltips: push = 'Publish branch' (no upstream) / 'Push N commit(s)' / 'Push'; pull = 'Pull N commit(s)' / 'Pull'; fetch = 'Fetch from remote'. Branch pill radius 14, height 28. Glyphs: fetch E895, pull E896, push E898, refresh E72C, branch E8AB. Fetch/pull/push/commit disabled while any git op runs.
cross_platform_plan: HTML buttons with SVG icons (Segoe MDL2 glyphs do not exist on macOS; use an icon set such as Lucide/Codicons inline SVG). Tooltips via title attribute or custom tooltip. Commands run through a Rust git command (see Git runner feature).

name: Git command runner (async, no prompts)
description: All git calls run in the background and post results back to the UI; never blocks or pops a console.
behavior_details: Runs 'git <args>' with working dir = repo, CreateNoWindow, stdout/stderr redirected as UTF-8, optional stdin (used for commit messages via -F -). Env GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 (never hang waiting for credentials) and LANG=en_US.UTF-8. Callback receives (exitCode, stdout, stderr); exceptions (git missing) -> code -1 with message in stderr. RunTagged variant passes a tag back so stale responses (user moved selection) are ignored.
cross_platform_plan: Rust tauri::command `git_run(dir, args: Vec<String>, stdin: Option<String>) -> {code, stdout, stderr}` using std::process::Command (tokio spawn_blocking), args as a Vec (no shell quoting; drop the Q() quoting helper). Set GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0, LANG/LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8, and on Windows CREATE_NO_WINDOW (0x08000000) via CommandExt::creation_flags. macOS GUI apps get a minimal PATH (/usr/bin:/bin...): resolve git from login shell PATH (e.g. fix-path-env crate or `zsh -lc 'echo $PATH'` once at startup) so Homebrew git and credential helpers work; /usr/bin/git may trigger Xcode CLT install prompt if missing - detect and show a message. Frontend handles staleness by request id/tag comparison. Consider also GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 for the 4s status poll.

name: Status message line (progress/errors)
description: A thin line at the bottom of the git view shows progress ('Fetching...'), the last line of git's output on success, or errors in red. Successes auto-hide.
behavior_details: Set-GitMsg(text, -Err, -Quiet). Hidden when text empty. Error color = Theme.Danger, otherwise Muted. A 4000 ms timer hides non-error messages, but only if no git op is busy; errors stay until replaced. Error text = first 2 non-empty lines of stderr+stdout joined by two spaces, or 'git failed (exit N)'. Success text = last non-empty line of stdout+stderr, or 'Done'. Ellipsized to one line, mnemonics disabled.
cross_platform_plan: Footer div with text-overflow: ellipsis; setTimeout 4000 to hide success messages, cleared when busy. Same rules.

name: Repo discovery for selected folder/project (multi-repo picker)
description: The git view targets the repo of the sidebar selection. If a folder holds several repos in sub-folders, or a project group has several folders/repos, a repo picker button appears; its menu lists repos with a checkmark on the current one.
behavior_details: Get-RepoCandidates(path): includes path itself if it has .git (file or dir, so worktrees/submodules count); scans sub-folders 1 level and 2 levels deep for .git, skipping 'node_modules' and names starting with '.'; stops after >40 repos; errors ignored. Cached per lowercased path for 30 s. Group selected: no folders -> nothing; union of candidates across all group folders (unique); if none found, the folder paths themselves (so the first shows 'not a git repository'). Folder selected: 0 or 1 repos -> no picker, use that repo or the folder path; >1 -> picker. Picker keeps the previous pick if still in the list, else first. Menu labels = leaf name, or 'parent\leaf' when two repos share a leaf name; tooltip = full path; folder icon; click sets GitPick and Refresh-Git. Pick not persisted.
cross_platform_plan: Rust command `find_repos(path)` with the same depth/skip/40 limit rules and a 30s in-memory cache (HashMap keyed by lowercase on Windows; case-sensitive keys are fine on macOS, but compare case-insensitively since APFS is usually case-insensitive). Use Path::join and display with the OS separator ('parent/leaf' on macOS). Picker menu as HTML dropdown.

name: Refresh-Git and non-repo empty states
description: Loads the repo for the current selection and shows clear empty states.
behavior_details: Only runs when git view visible. No selection / path missing -> clears list, diff shows 'Select a folder in the sidebar', hides branch, clears sync label, message and count. Runs 'git rev-parse --show-toplevel' in folder; non-zero -> diff shows '<leaf> is not a git repository, and no repositories were found in its sub-folders.\n\nRight-click it in the sidebar to open it in VS Code, or run 'git init' there.' and status 'Not a git repository'. Success -> GitRepo = toplevel (forward slashes converted to backslashes), Load-Status, and Load-History if history tab is visible. Triggered by: entering git view, sidebar selection change (while git visible), Refresh button, repo picker.
cross_platform_plan: Same flow. Only convert '/' to '\' on Windows (std::path canonicalization, or keep git's forward slashes and normalize with dunce on Windows). On macOS suggest 'Open in VS Code' still valid.

name: Changes list (staged / changes sections)
description: VS Code style list with 'STAGED CHANGES' and 'CHANGES' section headers with counts, each file showing name, dimmed directory and a colored status letter. Hover reveals inline action icons. Header 'Changes N' tab label, session-count label shows 'N changes' or 'clean', commit button reads 'Commit N staged'.
behavior_details: Runs 'git status --porcelain=v1 -b -z --untracked-files=all'. Parsing: split on NUL; skip entries <3 chars; '## ' line -> Set-Branch; X=e[0], Y=e[1], path=e[3..]; for R or C in X skip next entry (old name). '??' -> changes with status 'U' (untracked). XY matching U, AA or DD -> changes with status '!' (conflict). Else X!=' ' -> staged with status X; Y!=' ' -> changes with status Y (file can appear in both). Staged section omitted if empty; Changes section always shown (even with 0). Name = leaf, Dir = parent. Pluralization '1 change' / 'N changes'. Error -> red message with stderr. After loading, refreshes the diff if Changes tab visible. Arrow Up/Down navigation in list; selection changes update the diff. Double-click a file (not on an action icon) opens it in VS Code. Hover actions: file in Staged = Open file, Unstage; file in Changes = Open file, Discard changes, Stage; Staged header = Unstage all; Changes header = Discard all changes, Stage all. Icons: open E8E5, discard E7A7, stage E710, unstage E738; cursor turns to hand on an action.
cross_platform_plan: Parse porcelain in Rust (return typed JSON {branch, upstream, ahead, behind, staged[], changes[]}) or TS. Virtualized HTML list with hover action buttons (show on :hover and on keyboard focus). Paths from git are '/' separated; display dir with platform separator. Status colors as CSS tokens (M yellow, A/U green, D red, R blue, ! red).

name: Stage / unstage / discard actions
description: Per-file and bulk staging and discarding from the hover icons.
behavior_details:
stage -> 'git add -- <path>'; unstage -> 'git restore --staged -- <path>'; stageAll -> 'git add -A'; unstageAll -> 'git reset -q'; open -> launch VS Code with full path (if file exists). discard on untracked (U) file: confirm 'Delete the new file '<path>'?

It goes to the Recycle Bin.' (Yes/No, Warning) then move to Recycle Bin and Load-Status. discard on tracked: confirm 'Discard your changes to '<path>'?

This cannot be undone.' then 'git restore -- <path>'. discardAll: confirm 'Discard ALL changes to tracked files?

New (untracked) files are kept. This cannot be undone.' then 'git restore -- :/'. All go through Invoke-GitOp (ignored while another op is busy).
cross_platform_plan: Recycle Bin -> use Rust `trash` crate (Recycle Bin on Windows, Trash on macOS); dialog text should say 'Trash' on macOS. Confirms via a custom modal (matching app style) or tauri-plugin-dialog ask(). Note: discard of a conflict ('!') or staged-only items follows the same tracked path. Open file uses VS Code locator (see dependency).

name: Invoke-GitOp busy/refresh pipeline
description: Single serialized git operation with busy state and automatic refresh.
behavior_details: Ignored if no repo or another op is busy (no queueing). Sets busy, disables Fetch/Pull/Push/Commit, shows busy text. On completion: re-enable, show error or success message, run optional 'after' callback only on success, then Load-Status and Load-History if history visible. Commit message passed via stdin.
cross_platform_plan: Frontend busy flag + promise chain; same rules. Pass stdin through the Rust command.

name: Commit message box
description: Rounded multiline message box at the top of the left column with placeholder 'Message (Ctrl+Enter to commit)'; grows with content; accent border while focused.
behavior_details: Ctrl+Enter commits (key suppressed). Plain Enter inserts newline. Height = 24px + lines*fontHeight, lines clamped 1..6 (scroll beyond). Focus highlight stroke = accent. Cleared after successful commit/amend. Not persisted.
cross_platform_plan: <textarea> with auto-grow (rows 1-6). Shortcut: Ctrl+Enter on Windows, Cmd+Enter on macOS (accept both); placeholder text per platform ('Message (⌘↵ to commit)').

name: Commit split button and commit menu
description: Full-width 'Commit' button with check glyph; its arrow opens a menu: Commit & Push | Amend last commit | Undo last commit | Stash all changes | Pop latest stash | Open folder in VS Code.
behavior_details: Main click -> Invoke-Commit. Empty message -> red 'Type a commit message first.' and focus box. No staged files: if no changes -> 'There is nothing to commit.'; else confirm 'There are no staged changes. Stage all changes and commit them?' (Yes/No) then 'git add -A' then commit (smart commit). Commit = 'git commit -F -' with message on stdin ('Committing...'); on success clear box, and if Commit & Push then Invoke-GitPush (publish if no upstream). Amend: message present -> 'commit --amend -F -' else 'commit --amend --no-edit' ('Amending...'), clears box. Undo last commit: confirm 'Undo the last commit? Its changes stay in your working tree, staged.' -> 'git reset --soft HEAD~1'. Stash all: 'git stash push -u -m "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm from Claude Manager"' ('Stashing...'). Pop: 'git stash pop' ('Applying stash...'). Open folder in VS Code -> Open-InCode(GitRepo). Menu anchored under the button, right-aligned (x = width-230). Button text 'Commit N staged' when staged>0.
cross_platform_plan: HTML split button + dropdown. Same git args passed as arg vectors (stash message as a single arg, no quoting). Format date with local time.

name: Branch menu (switch / create branch)
description: Clicking the branch pill lists local branches with a checkmark on the current one, then 'Create new branch...'.
behavior_details: Runs 'git branch --format=%(HEAD)%09%(refname:short)'; '*' marks current. Click -> 'git switch <name>' ('Switching to <name>...'). Create: Ask-Name dialog 'New branch' / 'Name for the new branch (created from the current one):'; whitespace runs replaced by '-'; 'git switch -c <name>' ('Creating <name>...'). Branch name parsed from status header: text before '...', stripping 'No commits yet on '. Upstream = header contains '...'. ahead/behind parsed from '[ahead N, behind M]'. Remote branches are not listed.
cross_platform_plan: HTML dropdown + in-app name prompt modal (dependency: Ask-Name from another slice). Same commands. Detached HEAD shows 'HEAD (no branch)' as git prints it; keep.

name: Diff view for working-tree changes
description: Right pane shows a unified diff of the selected file with old/new line number gutters, colored added/removed lines, hunk headers; new untracked files shown as all-added.
behavior_details: Selection key 'section|path|status' guards against stale responses. Untracked (U): read file directly; missing -> 'File not found'; >2 MB -> '<name> is a large new file (X.X MB)'; contains NUL -> '<name> is a new binary file'; else ShowNewFile. Staged -> 'git diff --cached --no-color -- <path>'; changes -> 'git diff --no-color -- <path>'; empty -> 'No text changes'. 'Binary files' line -> 'Binary file not shown'. No selection -> 'Select a file to see its changes'. Diff parses '@@ -a,b +c,d' for line numbers. Mouse wheel scroll 3 lines/notch (smooth animated); Shift+wheel horizontal scroll; gutter stays fixed over horizontally scrolled text; Ctrl+C copies the whole diff as text with +/-/space prefixes. Monospace font: Cascadia Mono > Cascadia Code > Consolas at 9pt.
cross_platform_plan: Render diff in HTML (virtualized for big diffs) or use a library (diff2html, or Monaco diff editor for side-by-side). Read untracked file in Rust with the 2MB/NUL checks (read as lossy UTF-8). Font stack: 'Cascadia Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace. Copy shortcut Cmd+C on macOS; native text selection is a bonus. Horizontal scroll via overflow-x with sticky gutter.

name: Changes | History tabs
description: Text tabs under the commit button switch the left column between the changes list and commit history.
behavior_details: Tab labels 'Changes  N' (N = total changes, omitted when 0) and 'History'. History tab -> shows history list and Load-History; Changes tab -> Show-SelectedDiff. Not persisted.
cross_platform_plan: HTML tabs; same behavior.

name: History list with commit graph
description: Commit history across all local/remote branches and tags, with a colored lane graph, ref pills (current branch marked with *), subject and short relative age.
behavior_details: 'git log --branches --remotes --tags HEAD --date-order -n 400 --pretty=format:%H%x1f%P%x1f%s%x1f%an%x1f%ar%x1f%D%x1e' (record sep 0x1E, field sep 0x1F). Graph via GitGraph.Layout(hashes, parents, isHead) - lane algorithm: commit takes the lane waiting for it or a free/new lane with a new color; incoming lanes bend into the dot; first parent continues lane (or joins an existing lane waiting for it); other parents get free lanes with new colors; trailing empty lanes trimmed; HEAD commit marked; merges flagged. Graph width capped at 8 lanes. Ref pills: split %D by ', ', drop 'HEAD' and '*/HEAD', 'HEAD -> x' becomes '*x', 'tag: ' prefix removed. Age shortened: 'ago' removed, seconds->s, minutes->m, hours->h, days->d, weeks->w, months->mo, years->y, ', ' -> ' ' (e.g. '1y 2mo'). Columns 'Commit' (200, stretch) and 'When' (52). Row height 34. Author parsed but not shown. If nothing selected -> diff 'Select a commit to see its changes'. Selecting a commit -> 'git show --no-color --stat --patch --format=fuller <hash>' in diff view ('Empty commit' if blank), stale-guarded by key 'commit|<hash>'.
cross_platform_plan: Port GitGraph.Layout to TS (pure function) and draw with SVG/canvas per row. Same git args. Consider virtualized list for 400 rows. Format ages in TS from %at timestamps instead of regex on %ar (locale-proof), keeping the same short output.

name: Git split layout
description: Left column (message, commit, tabs, list) and right diff pane separated by a 1px draggable splitter.
behavior_details: Left min 260px, left panel fixed on resize. On first time the view is shown with width >500px: left = clamp(width*0.34, 290, 380). Also refit on each Show-GitView(true). Splitter position not persisted.
cross_platform_plan: CSS grid with a draggable divider (pointer events); min 260px; initial width clamp(290px, 34%, 380px). Optional persistence in settings.

name: Auto status refresh (4 s poll)
description: Changes list stays current while the source control view is visible.
behavior_details: Timer every 4000 ms runs Load-Status only if git view visible AND the window has focus AND no op busy AND a repo is set. (History not reloaded by the poll.)
cross_platform_plan: setInterval 4000 gated by document.hasFocus()/visibility and busy flag; or better, a Rust notify-based watcher on the repo (ignoring .git/index.lock churn) with debounce. Use GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 to avoid lock contention with the user's own git.

name: Sidebar row events (select, activate, chevron, Delete key)
description: Selecting a sidebar row updates the sessions list (and git view); double-click/Enter on a group toggles collapse, on a folder starts a new session; chevron toggles; Delete key deletes the group or folder entry.
behavior_details: SelectionChanged -> Fill-Sessions and, if git visible, Refresh-Git. RowActivated: group/other -> Toggle-Row; folder -> Do-New (new Claude session in that folder). ChevronClicked -> Toggle-Row. Delete key: group selected -> Remove-ProjectGroup; folder -> Do-DeleteProject. Session list: SelectionChanged -> Show-Details; RowActivated (double-click/Enter) -> Do-Resume; Delete -> Do-DeleteSession.
cross_platform_plan: Keyboard handlers on list containers. Delete key on Windows; on macOS map Cmd+Backspace and Fn+Delete (Delete) as well. Enter/Return activates.

name: Drag a folder onto a project group
description: Drag a folder row onto a project group to move it there, or onto Ungrouped to remove it from its group.
behavior_details: Only source rows of Kind 'folder' are accepted. Target group -> Move-ToGroup(path, groupName); any other target -> Move-ToGroup(path, null) (ungroup). Saves settings (in Move-ToGroup).
cross_platform_plan: HTML5 drag and drop (or pointer-based DnD for smoother feedback) within the sidebar; highlight target group. Note Tauri's window dragDropEnabled must stay true for external file drops (see below) - internal HTML5 DnD on Windows breaks when dragDropEnabled is true in WebView2; use pointer-event based DnD for internal moves to avoid the conflict.

name: Search dropdown (projects, folders, sessions)
description: Typing in the top search field shows a dropdown under it with sections PROJECTS (max 4), FOLDERS (max 6) and SESSIONS (max 8); arrows move, Enter opens, Esc closes.
behavior_details: Debounce 120 ms after typing. Matching is case-insensitive substring (-like *q*); names starting with the query rank first. Groups: name match; sub = 'N folder(s)'; group icon in accent. Folders: leaf name match; sorted by rank then last activity desc; sub = 'in <group>' or parent folder leaf; right = relative age if it has sessions; live dot level from LiveCwd. Sessions: match on full prompt text, excluding '(no prompt)' sessions; newest first; sub = '<cwd leaf>  ·  <profile name>'; right = 'working' (live level 2) / 'open' (live) / age. No hits -> "No results for '<q>'". Popup width = max(search width, 460px). Down: moves selection or opens popup; Up: moves; Enter: flush debounce, open if needed, pick selected; Esc: close+clear and focus sidebar. Picking: closes search, leaves an active terminal view (Select-Term null) to show main view; group -> select 'g:<name>'; folder -> expand its group (sets collapsed=false and saves, sets ShowAllFolders) and select 'f:<path>'; session -> select its folder, select the session row, Do-Resume (resumes or focuses if already open). Clear (x) button visible when text non-empty. Blur: after 150 ms hide unless field focused or cursor over popup; also hides on window deactivate (unless cursor over popup); repositions on window move; re-shows on focus if text present.
data_sources: settings.json groups (+ collapsed write); in-memory session index; live session state
cross_platform_plan: HTML absolutely-positioned dropdown inside the webview (no separate window needed, so move/deactivate handling becomes simple: close on blur/click outside and on window blur event). Same ranking/limits; do filtering in TS over the session index from Rust, or a Rust search command for large indexes. Profile name dependency (accounts slice).

name: Global keyboard shortcuts
description: F5 = full refresh; Ctrl+F = focus search; Esc clears search text; Ctrl+Enter commits; Enter resumes session; Delete deletes; arrows navigate lists and search.
behavior_details: Form-level KeyDown (KeyPreview assumed): F5 -> Refresh-All -Full (rebuild session index); Ctrl+F -> search.Focus(); Escape when search has text -> clear it. Other keys per-control as listed in other features. DiffView Ctrl+C copies diff.
